::: {#sol-load-tensor}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

digits = pd.read_csv("data/optdigits-test.csv", header=None)
pixels = digits.iloc[:, :64].to_numpy()
images = torch.tensor(pixels.reshape(-1, 8, 8))
labels = torch.tensor(digits[64].to_numpy())
n_images = images.shape[0]
print(images.shape, labels.shape)
print(images[0])
```

`torch.tensor` copies a NumPy array into a [tensor](#def-tensor).
The images make a tensor of [shape](#def-shape) (`r py$n_images`, 8, 8):
a stack of `r py$n_images` grids, each with 8 rows and 8 columns.
The labels make a tensor of shape (`r py$n_images`,), one number per image.

:::
